clauses.explanationTr: Dropbox, bir ihlal durumunda, hesabınızı anında kapatabilir ve verilerinizi dışa aktarmanıza izin vermeden erişimi kesebilir.
clauses.quote: We’ll provide you with reasonable advance notice via the email address associated with your account to remedy the activity that prompted us to contact you and give you the opportunity to export Your Stuff from our Services. If after such notice you fail to take the steps we ask of you, we’ll terminate or suspend your access to the Services.

clauses.explanationTr: Açıkça belirtilen durumlarda Dropbox, önceden bildirimde bulunmadan veya verilerinizi dışa aktarmanıza izin vermeden hesabınızı kapatabilir.
clauses.quote: We won’t provide notice or an opportunity to export Your Stuff before termination or suspension of access to the Services where Dropbox reasonably believes: you’re in material breach of these Terms, which includes, but is not limited to, violating our Acceptable Use Policy , doing so would cause us legal liability or compromise our ability to provide the Services to our other users, or we're prohibited from doing so by law.

clauses.explanationTr: Dropbox, sorumluluğunu yalnızca $20 veya ödenen ücretin %100'üne sınırlıyor; bu, beklenmedik zararlar için yeterli olmayabilir.
clauses.quote: WE LIMIT OUR LIABILITY TO YOU TO THE GREATER OF $20 USD OR 100% OF ANY AMOUNT YOU'VE PAID UNDER YOUR CURRENT SERVICE PLAN WITH DROPBOX.
